confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Suzhou price indexes. The food and drink anchors come from that one price search. It returned crowdsourced and sometimes dated figures: cappuccino about ¥22-35, inexpensive meal ¥25-40, mid-range dinner for two about ¥200, and restaurant beer anywhere from ¥7 to ¥80 depending on venue. Cocktail and wine are not directly sourced. I set them from the restaurant and bar beer price and typical Chinese bar markups. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge and comparison with similar Yangtze Delta cities, not from booking pages or listings. The RBA rate is the 18 November 2026 observation found in search results. It is later than the July 2026 pricing window, but it is the latest available.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other Yangtze River Delta tourist cities such as Hangzhou and Wuxi, with prices somewhat below Shanghai.
